bull.b: The platform’s differentiated resolution and reproducibility could support defensible adoption in research and drug discovery. External collaborations and demonstrated biological insights strengthen technical validation, although commercial scale still must be proven.

Concentrating resources on proteoforms gives the company a clearer product and assay strategy than pursuing broadscale applications equally. A staged roadmap may improve execution focus and create multiple future commercialization opportunities.

Lower operating expenses and a stated cash runway provide time to advance the product roadmap before substantial commercialization. This financial flexibility can support development milestones, though continued losses mean the runway is not self-sustaining.

bear.b: The company remains pre-commercial or only early commercial, with revenue far below the cost base and no evidence of operating scale. Persistent large losses indicate that profitability depends on successful future launches and substantial customer adoption.

bear.t: Cash burn and future financing requirement
bear.b: Cash consumption remains substantial despite reported cost improvements, and management anticipates raising capital before mid-2027. New debt or equity could constrain flexibility or dilute existing holders if commercialization milestones take longer.

Delaying broadscale availability removes a potentially important near-term application and shifts dependence toward the narrower proteoform roadmap. Extended probe, modeling and architecture work increases uncertainty around timing, scope and eventual customer demand.
